title: Alembic: Alchemy and Potion Making Sound Effects
shortText: 114 alchemy sound effects: pours by viscosity, a brew by heat, glassware, mortar, burner, reactions. WAV + OGG.
html:
Potion making in sound: pours by viscosity, a brew you set by heat, and the alchemist's whole bench

114 alchemy sound effects: glassware, a tincture, a syrup and quicksilver poured into a vial, a flask and a cauldron, a brew at 4 heats from a simmer to a rolling boil, the mortar on four ingredients, the burner, reactions that work and reactions that fail, the bench itself, three workshops as stackable beds and 17 seamless loops.

Licence, up front

Royalty free. Commercial use. No credit required. No revenue limit, no unit cap, no second licence to buy later if your game does well. Use it in as many projects as you like, on any platform. The one thing you may not do is resell the sounds themselves as sounds. The full plain language terms ship as LICENSE.txt, with a copy paste credit line if you want one.

Everything is synthesised from code. No recordings, no sample libraries, no third party clips, so there is no upstream licence behind this one and nobody can content ID claim these sounds against your project.

Hear it first

There is a free demo on this page: 21 sounds copied unaltered from the paid files. One tincture into all three vessels and all three liquids into one flask, the brew at its lowest and highest heat, the workshop with both of its layers, and the burner lit, burning, turned off and sputtering out.

What is in it

  • Glassware (22)
  • Liquids (25)
  • The brew (9)
  • Grind and cut (13)
  • Fire (10)
  • Reactions (13)
  • The bench (16)
  • Places (6)

Three liquids, three vessels

A thin tincture sprays small bubbles under a bright stream, a syrup falls slowly and surfaces in big separate glugs, and quicksilver takes in no air at all: it beads and patters. A vial and a flask rise in pitch as they fill, the air column above the liquid getting shorter; a cauldron is too deep for that, so its pour is lower and longer. The liquid changes the sound in every vessel and the vessel changes it for every liquid: 9 vessel pairs and 9 liquid pairs measured apart on the shipped files, 0 too close.

A brew you set by heat

4 seamless loops of one length, from a simmer (a few big lazy bubbles) to a rolling boil (every size at once, the surface spitting, steam over it). Map a brewing timer or a heat value to a rung and cross-fade as it climbs. Each rung is brighter than the one below, measured from the files (3 steps, 0 failing). Plus the heat coming on, the boil settling and single big bubbles.

The bench

Glassware set down, clinked, stoppered and uncorked, a glass rod stirring, a crack and a shatter. The mortar and pestle on dry herb, crystal, bone and seed, chopping and sieving. The burner and bellows, a flare up and embers. Reactions: success (glass tinks at random pitches, never a tune), a puff, a sizzle dying away, smoke, a failed reaction's pop, a crackling transmutation and a flash boil. Brass scale weights, a jar lid, a drawer, pages, a tome and a quill. And three places, an alchemist's workshop, a cellar laboratory and a hedge witch's hut, each a bed and a detail layer of one length that stack (6 stacks re-summed from the shipped files). Two lifecycles, the burner and the brew, ship as start, loop and stop (7 states, every loop flag read out of the file).

Already own our other packs?

Where this pack fills a role one of 17 of our other packs already fills (a glass set down, a cork, a pour, a drip, bubbling, steam, a flame, a quill, a page, a shatter), the two were measured against each other from both packs' files: 47 shared roles, every one a different sound.

Fit

  • WAV and OGG for every file, 16 bit, 44.1 kHz, mono, with a manifest listing every file by slot.
  • 17 seamless loops with sample accurate loop points in the WAV and the OGG.
  • One loudness band: the inner 80 percent of the pack sits inside 1.6 dB.
  • pack_proof.json ships with the pack: 1055 checks, 0 failed.
  • No voices, no spell casting, no creatures and nothing musical, so it sits under any score.

Honest limits

These are synthesised sounds, not recordings of a real laboratory. The measurements above are signal measurements, not a claim that it sounds good. That is what the free demo is for.

AI disclosure, stated truthfully: the code that generates these sounds was written with AI assistance. The sounds themselves are self contained procedural synthesis, with no generative audio model at any point. The cover art and store graphics are AI generated.

More from the same studio

  • Sixfold, elemental spell casting from the charge to the impact, for the magic your potions sit beside.
  • Dwell, places as layered beds, a scriptorium and a forge among them.
  • Wade, liquids, splashes, pours and drips for everything outside the workshop.
